en: It looks very mysterious, but no more mysterious than the person wearing it.
Very... planty?
A battlewear of a yaara keeper. It's probably venomus, better not touch it.
Full protection to every alta. I hope someday we're able to give this equipment to every varda out there.
First line of protection of all the precious research we've made and knowledgge we've gained.
Pretty and effective. I like the calin-like shiny rims on this dress.
The smell of science is coming from this piece of clothing...
So warm and cozy, yet also so protective!
I love these! Now all we need is a matching target board to put on a wall...
You can look like a camouflaging EDS soldier with this helmet.
This mask belongs to a yaara keeper. Am I allowed to wear it?
I mean, this is just helpful for any kind of work with your head down, especially for altas that don't like putting their hair in a tail.
I've heard that all of the most powerful altas are indeed named after flowers... Is this story true?!
This is a stardust-charged astera fixator. Wondering how else I can put it to use. Some say that ^#6f6c66;spacedrifters^reset; often use them in combat...
The spread of warped growth is a prominent topic, especially since it tends to contaminate yaara groves and many underground facilities.
Safety is important, so I'm glad that decisions around modular ship parts are being given this much thought.
This is not a very decent thing to wear on its own. Perhaps I should put something under it.
A special yonnur mixture that's supposed to illuminate the space around it. Not sure how effective it is.
I like it when it's raining. Especially if I don't have to go outside and can just watch it through the window.
Energy-based bood is the best, considering our bodies run on plasma...
You're telling me I can cook by the book to cook better than by the book?!
It's like a huge visor, that takes up all of your face!
Looks very battle-esque, with the camo paint and everything, although altas don't really use these palettes.
That small, tiny point of a vir, can see and capture your every move...
An ^#f08f20;Arco^reset; report on the stability of an ion core. The anomaly bit in the end makes me a little cautious.
I wonder how recent this is. Maybe I can get my hands on some of that stuff?
Very comfortable to wear actually, even if you're not in combat.
A friendly medical glow of this mask gives me reassurance.
This document gives you a good perspective into the safety approach around research bases, and how each safety protocol set is tailored specifically for its lab.
The pinnacle of alta engineering for elite operatives.
This book is a great way to learn about our crystal-based cuisine and its history.
One can definitely feel their step in these.
These leggings make you slightly taller, or so I've heard. Would be neat to try, since we're all the same height.
Wearing these feels like you're operating a mini-mech of sorts.
This guide showcases the beauty and diversity of iora gyera parks pretty well.
That's why I always double-lock my candy stash during Ceternity!
A prime forces helmet. Looks similar to varda captain's helmet, but with even more protection.
It feels a bit weird reading this, knowing that it's technically still happening.
Love the sight of what looks like thousands of tiny falling stars igniting the sky. The best light show there is.
If I were to learn from this, could I possibly become an arknight myself one day?
Ooh, I should probably go here sometime!.. Wherever this is.
I can't believe this project is actually real...
I think this is what MKI intruders use to make our tech look like Miniknog's.
This guide is very helpful for wrapping your head around the various crystal species and subspecies found around alterash...
Energy is the primary ingredient of life. I should make sure I always have enough of it.
Ashal to you too, little card!
So bright! Looks pretty similar to unona wood.
So pretty!
So similar to ionic ferment, except less... ionic?
I love the texture of reed blocks! They make rooms feel so natural.
Basic crafting material! You can find these almost everywhere with plants.
So pretty and glowy! Also, some of them can be used to extract yonnur, to make other things glow just as much!
So soft and fluffy! Perfect for making comfy clothes~
This is what we use for bandages and soft padding. Very practical!
Basic fabric. Altas try to use more pleasant materials, like silk and cotton. Or, well, bion.
This is what the silk is made from!
Quality fabric! Good for art and crafting, though I still prefer silk.
Living root thread! The organic enhancement is such a clever idea~
Basic string! You never know when you'll need it for something~
Wow, this is HUGE! So soft and delicate despite its size~
Pretty blue! This would make such a nice dye for fabrics.
Such a vivid red! I wonder what flower this came from?
Sunny and bright! This would make everything look so cheerful~
Squishy and wet! I wonder if this variety is edible? Some seaweed makes great snacks!
These look so wild and untamed! You could probably swing from them... maybe?
So pretty! I wish there was an armor set made from these... Oh wait.
It never melts! Like a perfect soneva specimen that stays frozen forever~
Didn't know that you could use stardust crystals like that... Neat!
Such beautiful triangles! The geometry is so satisfying to look at~
I think I've read about this ore, and how it can be found on some ionic planets due to their moon-like nature.
Thank you Io for all this titanium.
So, this is where these dark metals come from...
Durasteel can be one of the base components for ^#f02020;EDS armor^reset; pieces. Or so I've heard.
Nice warm color! Though it oxidizes... Why not use altan or crystals instead?
Standard iron ore. Does the job, but nothing special compared to what we have!
Other species' basic metal! We were lucky to have titanium naturally on our planets.
Shiny alien metal! Good for conductivity, but we usually just use our own materials.
Pretty conductive metal! Sometimes our scientists import this for special projects.
Another alien metal! Shiny, but we have plenty of better materials on alterash already.
Very heavy alien ore! I wonder what it's like to have this naturally on your planet?
Dense alien metal bar! Interesting, but we have our own ways of handling heat.
Heavy alien metal. Dense and practical, but not something we use much.
Rare fancy alien metal! I heard it's super resistant to corrosion, whatever that means.
Rare ore from cold planets! This is actually useful for our advanced tech~
Refined and ready! Perfect for high-tier protective equipment.
Another cold planet ore! These frozen star materials are so interesting.
Refined ferozium! Always exciting to work with these advanced materials.
Violium! One of the rare materials we actually use in our best equipment~
Refined violium is so versatile! Great for all sorts of advanced projects.
It's so warm! Fascinating how this ore naturally generates heat like that.
Refined and still warm! The heat properties are so stable and consistent~
Pretty but radioactive! We have to be really careful with this one.
Extremely dangerous to handle! Why would anyone want this when we have phospholion?
Radioactive fuel ore. Useful, but not as elegant as our energy sources!
Fuel rod! Works as intended, though I prefer our alta energy solutions.
Basic alien fuel! Interesting to see what other species burn for energy.
WOW, instant full fuel?! That's amazing! Though our energy cells work great too.
Tiny piles of these can sparkle so beautifully in the night sky!
I should be... cautious of it? But it's so pretty!..
Looks like a piece of heat-based alta technology. Not sure of its purpose.
Imported alien technology. Pretty neat, although I'm a bit afraid of teleportation and its consequences.
So chill! Others say it often comes from izopoi.
Standard space polymer! We make our own versions with bion compounds too.
This... doesn't even feel good, you feel me?
Smells weird but useful! Good for chemical experiments and reactions.
While mostly tasteless, I feel like it adds something to the dish... Healthiness probably?
Cellular material! I wonder what biological processes created this?
Unspeakable crafting material... That sounds ominous. Better handle it carefully!
Woah, it reacts when I touch it! Reminds me of some bionid samples.
You can eat these or make a curry from them! I told this to one of my human friends and they shrieked in horror. Humans.
WHO WOULD DO SOMETHING LIKE THIS?! Why-y?..
Ancient fossil! I wonder what creature this was? So much history preserved!
Interesting skeletal structure! Tells us so much about biology and evolution.
Empty bug shell! Insects shed these as they grow - it's fascinating biology~
Natural armor plating! Creatures evolved some impressive protective structures.
Solid clay brick! Nice texture, though we usually build with stronger materials.
Metal-coated wood? Creative combination! Though composites are more efficient.
Hehe, 'a block that matters'! Clever name for fundamental matter material.
Regular poi. You can cook it, or throw it at your friends and laugh at them!
Some say it's useless, I say that, just like poi, you can throw it at your friends and laugh loudly in their face.
Erm, glass? Please use crystals next time.
Why make them from glass? Why make anything from glass? Aliens, huh.
Glass mug for hot drinks! Fragile though... why not use crystal instead?
This is the standard base container for various enhancers.
Simple alien bandage! We have our own amiks - ayaka and bion ones work better~
Full medical kit! Handy for emergencies when shielders aren't enough.
Nanotech healing! Different approach from our bion methods, but impressive~
Plant-based healing! Natural remedies are always nice to see.
Jump boost stim! We prefer energy-based enhancements, but interesting chemistry~
Speed boost stim! Different approach from our ionic movement enhancements.
Rage-inducing stim?! That seems... dangerous. I'd prefer something more... balanced?
Glow stim! We use yonnur extracts for similar glowing effects~
Plant-based medicine! Natural healing methods are always worth studying.
Simple water in a glass bottle. Why not use a crystal container though?
Amazing healing water! Natural restoration power is always fascinating~
Universal poison antidote! We have our own netrimas for specific toxins.
Burn treatment spray! This chemical approach is interesting~
Mushroom-based poison protection! Aric medicine has such interesting properties~
Fungal remedy! Natural mushroom medicine is always worth studying for its unique properties.
Multi-effect synthetic stim! Complex chemistry... we prefer combining different energy types though~
Valentine chocolates! Can't wait for Ava Day to gift it to someone~ And chocolate is plant-based, so I can enjoy it too!
Erchius crystals! Essential for FTL travel, we have these on our planets too~
Red dye! Nice for accents, though I'm more used to omniblue and altan shades~
Orange! Warm and bright. Not typical for altas, but I like it for standing out~
Yellow dye! Cheerful and sunny, nice for casual outfits!
Green! Reminds me of alterash havens and yaara groves~
Blue! My favorite color! Though the altan dye has better shades~
Purple! Reminds me of enternia and ionic energy~
Pink! Stardust color! The combination of all three energies, so special~
Brown. Practical, I guess... but I'm used to brighter colors! Not really my style.
Black! Perfect for bion armor and EDS equipment - sleek and professional.
White! Clean and pure, shows off altan shine beautifully~
Grey. Good for titanium equipment, though not the most exciting color for me.
Dye remover! Useful for getting back to original altan colors~
Matter manipulator upgrade! Protectorate's modular design is smart - easy to swap and improve.
Universal upgrade module! Modular design is smart - easy to swap and improve.
Tech development card! We use datamasses for similar purposes~
Vehicle repair chip! Universal standards make cross-galactical travel easier and more convenient.
Penguin currency! Their mercenary economy is quite different from ours.
Protectorate currency! Recognition tokens for peacekeeping work.
Compressed pixels! Smart way to carry large amounts without bulk~
Even more compressed pixels! Efficient storage is always appreciated.
High-value voxel! Convenient for bigger purchases and trades.
Maximum compression voxel! Perfect for significant transactions~
Ancient vault key! I wonder what forgotten secrets it guards?
Ancient translation wheel! Left half. Wonder how their runes compare to alkey~
Ancient translation wheel! Right half. These ancient language tools are so interesting!
Ancient rune translation guide! Fascinating to see how other species preserved knowledge before energy-based systems~
Protectorate recruitment flyer! Historical artifact from before the Ruin. We preserve these~
Secret note! I love puzzles and hidden messages. Wonder what encryption method they used?
Winning ticket! Probability games are fascinating. The math behind random chance is beautiful~
Nicely wrapped parcel! I hope whoever it's for receives it safely~
I wonder what this used to be? The composition is unusual...
Trash?! Why not use proper recycling? What could be hidden in here?..
That's just... unfortunate...
Soggy paper! This is exactly why we prefer datamasses and crystal storage. So fragile!
Sheet music! Musical notation is universal language. I'd love to hear this performed~
Comedy script! Alien humor is so interesting to analyze. Wonder if they'd laugh at our jokes?
Oh wow, it's so tiny, yet so... majestic!
So warm and cozy! Natural heat generation is always fascinating to study.
Little garden gnome! I learned these are traditional decorations for some species.
Pure holiday energy! It's like concentrated joy and celebration in material form!
Ship autodrive! Automated navigation is convenient, though I prefer manual controls~
Tiny alien battery! We have our own versions, but this is a neat compact design~
Powerful alien processor! We usually build ours with crystals instead of silicon though.
Silicon circuits! We use calotronics with crystals - much prettier and more efficient~
Iron hinge from alien buildings! We use titanium hinges - they last much longer.
Robot with a living brain?! That's... really concerning. We use pure AI instead.
Mech arm parts! Useful for repairs or studying alien robotics design~
Mech body salvage! Waste not, want not - recycling tech is always smart.
Mech booster parts! Different propulsion approach from our energy systems.
Mech leg salvage! Heavy-duty design, much sturdier than our walker units.
High-grade salvage! Contains useful rare materials for advanced projects~
Elite-tier salvage! Fascinating advanced tech to analyze and learn from!
Legendary salvage! The pinnacle of alien tech - must study this carefully!
Canned food! Practical preservation, though I prefer crystal storage methods.
Animal product cheese. I can't eat it, but the fermentation chemistry is interesting!
Chocolate! Plant-based, so I can have it! Not traditional alta food, but tasty~
Animal eggs. I don't eat these, but they're interesting biological specimens to study.
Animal milk. Not for me since I'm herbivore, but fascinating from a biological standpoint!
Oculemons are such weird fruit! But the lemonade is surprisingly refreshing~
Universal soda brand! Different from our nia drinks, but the carbonation is fun.
Fizzy drink! We have our own carbonated beverages, but this is a classic alien version.
Monster claw trophy! Proof of a tough fight, and great for biological study~
Healing water in liquid form! Natural restoration properties are fascinating.
Bottled lava! Extremely dangerous but useful for heat research and volcanic studies.
Crude oil. Messy and outdated energy source! We prefer clean energy systems.
Poison liquid! Dangerous to handle, but useful for netrima (antidote) research.
Bottled slime! We have our own poi and isoslime varieties to compare~
Swamp water! So murky... I prefer the clean waters of our verriskoywas.
Pure water! Essential for life and so many uses in chemistry and biology~
Protectorate records! Important historical artifacts. Some altas were honorary members~
More Protectorate history! Their dedication to universal peace was truly admirable.
Esther Bright's journal! Reading about her finding Asra... it's like getting to know her personally. So much more relatable than official histories!
Yolotl's diary, entry 1! Personal diaries are so intimate. I love seeing life through someone else's eyes~
Yolotl's diary, entry 2! Following their story is like making a new friend.
Yolotl's diary, entry 3! Their journey continues. I wonder what happens next?
Yolotl's diary, final entry! Completing their story feels bittersweet... but meaningful.
Fascinating Apex intel! Their tech inspired our MKI operations, but the rebellion has my sympathy.
The surveillance methods are brilliant but... kind of dystopian?
Interesting to see both Miniknog and rebel approaches.
The whole picture makes me appreciate our own freedom more~
Avian culture is so exotic! The sacrifice stuff was... unexpected though.
Their faith shapes everything! So different from our scientific approach.
Grounded vs Stargazers... every society has its conflicts, I guess.
Now I understand them better! Still find the religious devotion intense though.
Occasus intel... Their destructive ideology is deeply concerning.
I hope we study these to protect against their threat.
And yet, florans are just plants... Organized, hunting plants!
Their hunting culture is intense. And yaara keepers actively oppose alta botanists!
The biology behind sentient flora is so interesting~
Now I understand their approach to territorial operations.
Robot consciousness doesn't feel as alien when I'm surrounded by our lovely drones~
Medieval culture meets advanced robotics - such a unique combination!
Their honor code is genuinely admirable.
Now I fully understand how they're different from us.
Love learning about Hylotl culture! Our knowledge exchange is so enriching~
Art and philosophy everywhere! Very Hylotl. Very beautiful~
Balancing pacifism with reality... that's wisdom right there.
Their sophistication inspires me! So much to learn.
Every document teaches me something new about beauty and knowledge~
Their dedication to documentation matches ours! Kindred spirits.
Thorough and beautiful - the Hylotl way!
Complete picture of a culture we deeply respect. Grateful for this exchange!
Moon base intel! Just as relevant on alterash I'd say~
Comparing their lunar approach to our alterash methods. Similar challenges!
The parallels are striking! Though our planets are more... ionic.
Everyone deals with low gravity differently.
Their systematic exploration approach is very... Apex.
Their exploration history ties into our own complex relationship.
Their poetic yet precise exploration records are beautiful~
Dangerous but... still a penguin. Kind of cute despite the menace?
What a dangerous electric creature. Must respect that threat level!
Medieval social structures are so different from ours~
The power dynamics are fascinating to follow.
Cultural values showing through leadership stories~
The narrative structure reveals so much about culture.
Medieval hierarchy reflected in every detail.
Complete story gives full picture of medieval society~
Hospitality customs are universal yet so different!
Cross-cultural conflicts... we know those well.
Sets up the whole medieval cultural context. Cosplay-ready.
Fascinating to compare alien settlement methods to our own~
Personal settlement experiences are so relatable.
Community dynamics developing over time~
Everyone faces settlement challenges differently.
Some parallels to our own settlement experiences!
Watching communities grow is always heartwarming.
Complete settlement journey - from nothing to thriving!
These last messages are always emotionally powerful ;-;
Plant architects designing structures - mind-blowing!
We all deal with travel challenges differently~
Underground movements... A tactic well-different from the MKI.
Everyone needs humor and lighthearted moments. Love it!
Cautionary tale for archaeologists - stay safe out there!
You should always be careful with these things. Viona, Warped, Void, Hevika, and many other unstable environments, changing the way you understand energy, but in ways less than safe to your health.
Time drifters are mysterious creatures, beyond our comprehension... Answering the question - no idea, what I would do with this kind of power. I don't think I need it in the first place.
Will I... be able to control myself, while it's on?..
Becoming a scout is a rite of passage for many aspiring ^#b0e0fc;altas^reset;.
The EDS sure has the defense part covered.
When I first saw it, I was wondering how vardas can see in this. Visors!
Some powerful thrusters to let you go far.
Makes me want to wrap up in blankets and celebrate right now! So cozy~
A nice middleground between official-ness and practicality.
Can get pretty dangerous in certain places. I'll need to bring my armored umbrella with me.
This girl got changed by viona... It's sad, but I'm glad that she's happy, and that she likes her new tail! I hope I could visit this party and hang out with them.
An advanced static shield. Much harder to produce, because it utilizes impulses instead of plasma.
This tiny shard is full of mysteries! It can be a liquid, or a crystal, or a crystal liquid, or a jam. I think I'm hungry.
This helmet kinda looks like it has a cap.
This can actually be dangerous. While staris cals are not that hard, having them hit you full force while falling from eva is not very fun.
An ^#f08f20;Arco^reset; report about miazmas - very dangerous clashes of different types of energies. I heard they can result in explosions, and sometimes even climate micro disasters.
Something similar to robotics AI, but for plant housing.
Yava cuisine is not as common I think - at least I'm a bit more used to crystals and pulps...
I love this story! It reminds me of the time I was just born, listening to my caretaker reading me bedtime stories.
Wait why is my hand moving back-- oh. OH. Got you! >>:3
I can jump so much higher in these! Like a real scava!
This looks like a crucial resource for new employees at Hevika Ordis... Shouldn't it be classified?
I've heard this book is often being read to newcomers to ^#b0e0fc;viona corfals^reset;, who weren't wary about viona's negative consequences.
It's full of poisonous insects. If'll throw it, I better make sure it lands somewhere far away from me.
This prototype seems to be related to the Dreamer project. I wonder what it could do?
While I'm a bit cautious, nivera plants can be quite useful in medicine I think, so these kinds of things are definitely worth the effort.
Makes you feel safe and secure in hazardous places.
It's better to grab an umbrella. Oh, and also hide all drois inside, just in case.
A hevia yon that's usually used to power hevika-based tech. With a bit of modification it can also be used as an actuator in some blasters!
Some gooey izopoi I can throw at my friends. Perfect.
A faradea frag. I think these are using ^#8080f0;viona^reset; anomalies as a damage tactic. Very creative.
Gheatsyn became an important part of alta tech due to its amazing abilities, so its nature and origins are definitely worth studying.
You do feel quite safe in stuff like this, especially with all the life support systems.
You could walk through fire in these easily.

Although we are usually created with that knowledge, or at least its general outlines, this can be exceptionally useful to someone else, or maybe as a part of a more global study, like the "Environmental Causes Of Crystallic Formations In Organic Creatures" one, or ^gray;"ECOC-FIOC"^reset;. Quite popular.
It's like eternal heat but instead you feel completely drained and tired. Not a very pleasant thing ro experience.
This seems like a brochure for an extra-terrestrial visitor, but as far as I know, these are sometimes being given to altas in some gardens "just in case".
I can't wait to go to this party! I should probably prepare my swimming gear...
I wonder if this is a real thing or just a myth...
This would probably be so heavy if it was made out of paper...
This looks like logs from an EDS server trying to reconnect... I wonder what happened to it?
I've heard this story is about a real asta, who once met an actual time drifter, thinking it's a ray of light. Very lovely.
An extremely precious yaara keeper relic. I should treat it with care.
Doesn't seem to be toxic, so probably safe to wear.
Will I become toxic if I wear this? I don't want to insult my friends...
I like what this flower represents. An how it sits on my hair, too.
This is quite a find. As far as I remember, these are not usually for sale.
I don't know how someone can not put it on their head immediately. So beautiful!
I would hug the stardust out of any alta wearing this.
I think I can kinda see through it? If I squint hard enough?
So cozy and inspiring! Makes you want to make yourself some tea and create something pretty.

Looks exciting!

Love poi-based desserts, and also icy stuff like ice creams and iced desserts. Though disturbing actual live poi for this is a bad idea, so I'm glad there are other ways to do this instead.
I think this part is about the Stardust Orchid... Was she the one that gathered everyone to go to Celestia?..
Reading this makes my heart flutter~ Such a beautiful experience to dream about!
This list looks endless... Can't believe how far we've come to protect ourselves - just to be safe...
This helped me cook my first cake. It was a bit sloppy, but it was delicious!
This looks important for Tifa... I hope she gets the job!~

I can make everyone behind me know what faction I'm a part of! Or, just let them know how cool I look in this.

Useful to have one of these with you when you're in space. Or I guess in lava?
Oaa, I used to have a set of these back in the CorFal! Except, well, smaller. I remember losing one at some point, but my caretaker found it a day later!
An EDS transmitter. Compatible with some body armor models, but there's always a useful adapter just in case.
Ooh, this almost looks like actual bion!

A scava's body armor, very light and bendable. I like the feel of it in my hands.
Wouldn't it be cool to become a virma tamer some day? And have a tentacle monster plant to protect you from all the silly poi?
I never actually knew this side of tavriya nature, if you could call it that. While tavriya does often have different plant-looking growth, most of is usually revealed to be of a different origin.
Tonna freshes are quite refreshing. Also, they go well with ^#b0e0fc;ometonnas^reset; and tarts, especially ^#b0e0fc;zandarm tart^reset; ones.
I can't believe how beautiful yet dangerous haven plants are. There goes my idea for a garden...
I can feel safer under the frotective aura of this thing.
Full protection to every alta. I hope someday we're able to give this equipment to evry varda out there.

The moral of the story is that you should be wary of tricky evil sentias, and to not fall for their love tricks, so you don't end up a plaything to treat their loneliness, and that there are good sentias too, who try to make friends in a less forceful way.
This story reminds you that it's ok to dream and wonder, and that it's a nice way of relaxation too!

Some altas can't help but wonder what it's like to traverse Io on your own and what kinds of things can happen, so on one hand I'm glad that books like this one exist, on the other I think they might be the reason why so many altas think about this in the first place.

Some of the aspects described in the document are very similar to ^gray;Bionid-C2-Prias-7^reset;, which I think was the most common variety in my area. Both of these are classified as corrosive, so lots of similarities. I think these are all called ^gray;"Nerigid"^reset; for short?
This set looks quite advanced. I wonder how well it would protect me in a fight?
No additional weight can be dismissed in exchange for a life.
The Empress's new year speech! Always makes me feel so hopeful and connected to all my sisters~
It looks so beautiful, yet I know what consequences lie behind wearing it.
Smells like ^#3587ff;blossoming ayaka^reset; leaves. Very romantic.
Object 17?.. That's a bit of an outdated naming convention... Is that... from Iceterion?..
I hope I never have to use this...
An armor piece this heavy requires a proper exoskeleton to wear.
Looks pretty bulky, but is actually quite comfy.
A gaush frag that can light things it touches up. Fire is dangerous, so this shouldn't be used unless necessary and authorized for a certain process.
Oh wow, some one hand-making devices! Is there a master class I could watch in my spare time?
Highly dangerous thermomix mod. I should be very careful with it.
It's so pretty! The koywa leaves are incredibly nice to the touch, perfect for a dancing skirt.
Oh no... I hope this isn't a bad sign.

Love it when it's raining, but the sun is still shining too! Very pleasant. Ionic drizzles are pretty warm, too, so wouldn't mind standing under one just because.

It's always important to adhere to safety rules and protocols, so nice to see this in an easy-to-read form.
This is the best part! It's about how we were created!
The best weather to ever be. I wish it was always snowing stardust wherever I go.
Reading this gives you a pretty good understanding of just how protected capitals are.
Useful when trying to master dendrarium.
This will help me understand how to create advanced, profile-specific fertilizers.
Many Project Ceterai associates used to wear this on-field. Now I could be the one utilizing it to the fullest.
Looks exactly how it tastes. Why would you taste a helmet? No idea.

Is this why the crystals are so powerful?
Very stylish. But also, those pretty tails are quite important to the whole proto system.

I would find this more useful if it a bit more... concise.
Soft touch, steady pattern. It feels… grounding. Like a warm hug from a sister.
